subject: Geopolitics
title: Cobalt and Congo
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Cobalt and Congo.

hook.text: 70% of the world's cobalt comes from Congo. Some of it is mined by children as young as seven.

buildup.text: Cobalt is essential for lithium-ion batteries. Every EV and phone needs it. Demand keeps climbing.

discovery.text: Congo's cobalt wealth funds both the economy and armed groups. The mineral is a blessing and a curse.

twist.text: Chinese firms control most of Congo's cobalt mines. Western companies arrived late and are playing catch-up.

climax.text: Tech companies pledge ethical sourcing. But tracing cobalt through opaque supply chains is nearly impossible.

punchline.text: Clean energy has a dirty secret buried in Congo.

quiz.question: Who controls most of Congo's cobalt mining operations?
